test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution:
The erroneous spelling is 'Occular'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The correct spelling for the word is *ocular *which means of or connected with the eyes or vision.
 
• The meanings of the other options are as follows - 
 
 
• Martinet - a person who demands complete obedience; a strict disciplinarian.
 
• Congenital - (of a disease or physical abnormality) present from birth.
 
• Phlegmatic - (of a person) having an unemotional and stolidly calm disposition.
 
 
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.
